title: Rectangular prism
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and a translation vector of zero, zero, and zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the defined plane. Begin by creating the first face with one loop. In this loop, draw four lines: the first line starts at zero, zero and ends at zero point zero two seven three, zero; the second line starts at zero point zero two seven three, zero and ends at zero point zero two seven three, zero point zero two seven three; the third line starts at zero point zero two seven three, zero point zero two seven three and ends at zero, zero point zero two seven three; the fourth line starts at zero, zero point zero two seven three and ends at zero, zero. Apply a scaling factor of zero point zero two seven three to the entire sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles of negative ninety degrees, zero degrees, and negative ninety degrees, and translating it using the translation vector of zero, zero, and zero. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by zero point seven five units to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular prism with rounded edges will be a length of zero point zero two seven three four three seven five units, a width of zero point zero two seven three four three seven five units, and a height of zero point seven five units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0273, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0273, 0.0273) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0273) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# Apply the coordinate system transformation
# The Euler angles (-90, 0, -90) correspond to a rotation of 90 degrees around the X-axis and then 90 degrees around the Z-axis
# The translation vector is [0, 0, 0], so no translation is needed
r = r.rotate((0, 0, 0), (1, 0, 0), 90) \
     .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), 90)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0273) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0273) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a cylinder
